MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice:
Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION-bound {PLAYER}?
The GYM LEADERS here use PSYCHIC-type POKéMON.
If you go up against them with FIGHTING- or POISON-type POKéMON, they'll inflict horrible damage!
Plus, they'll come at you with outstanding combination attacks.
If you want to win, you'll need to show them how tight you are with your POKéMON. Go for it!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictor: Wow, you're astounding! You're one great TRAINER!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonIntro: Battles hinge on the strength of your spirit! The weak-spirited will never win!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonDefeat: I lost! I must temper my spirit again!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonPostBattle: The indecisive lose. That's my warning to you.
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilPostBattle:
If there are prodigies in the world, then our GYM LEADERS are them!
However, you may be even more talented than them…
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeIntro:
Fufufufu… Watch me levitate a POKé BALL telekinetically!
Wrooooooooaaaar! … … … … … … …
Sometimes, I'm out of sync…
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeDefeat: My POKéMON battling skills are out of sync, too!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakePostBattle:
A POKé BALL was too heavy to lift psychically. But this dust bunny…
Whoooooooooooooooh! … … … … … …
No, I'm not cheating! I didn't blow on it! Honestly!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahIntro:
When you lose to me, don't be too hard on yourself.
It's not that you're weak--I'm just too strong!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahPostBattle:
I'm not going to get down on myself for losing. I just need to train harder.
Positive thinking--that's my strong point!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaIntro:
I see it… I see your future…
If you can beat me, I will tell you your future!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaPostBattle:
You will wage a terrifically intense battle with our GYM LEADERS…
The result… You won't hear it from me!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraIntro:
The roads you have traveled… What you have experienced…
Come at me with everything you've learned!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraDefeat: You've traveled a path of greatness!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraPostBattle:
A bright future awaits those who have worked diligently.
For those who lazed idly, there is only despair at the end.
What goes around comes around…
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaIntro: Even at the risk of life, I will win this battle!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaDefeat: What you do… It horrifies me…
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaPostBattle:
How dare you beat me…
It won't be my fault if something horrible befalls you…
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro:
Hohoho.
You need me to show you how tenacious the PSYCHIC type can be.
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateDefeat: Oh! My, my! Your battle style is fantastic!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle: I… I don't let defeat rattle m-me, however b-badly.
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenIntro: Let me show you a perfectly awful, horrifying time!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenPostBattle: Your vitality is contagious! Get away from me quickly!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordIntro: I may be past my prime, but I suggest you not patronize me.
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordDefeat: Ah, you overflow with the power of youth!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordPostBattle: It seems that I could not overcome your youthful energy.
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyIntro: You're not getting through to the end! Not if I can help it!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyDefeat: How could you be so ludicrously strong?
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyPostBattle:
Humph! You may be strong, but you're not suitable for the PSYCHIC type!
The way you battle is somehow brutal!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasIntro: Wroooar! Have a taste of my super POKéMON hard-battling power!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasPostBattle: All right! I think I'll develop a special invincible POKéMON power next.
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro:
TATE: Hehehe… Were you surprised?
LIZA: Fufufu… Were you surprised?
TATE: That there are two GYM LEADERS? LIZA: That there are two GYM LEADERS?
TATE: We're twins! LIZA: We're twins!
TATE: We don't need to talk because… LIZA: We can each determine what…
TATE: The other is thinking… LIZA: All in our minds!
TATE: This combination of ours… LIZA: Can you beat it?
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaDefeat:
TATE: What?! Our combination… LIZA: Was shattered!
TATE: It can't be helped. You've won… LIZA: So, in recognition, take this.
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedMindBadge: {PLAYER} received the MIND BADGE from TATE and LIZA.
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMindBadgeTa:
TATE: The MIND BADGE enhances the SP. ATK and SP. DEF of POKéMON.
LIZA: It also lets you use the HM move DIVE outside of battle.
TATE: You should also take this, too.
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainCalmMind:
TATE: That TM04 contains… LIZA: CALM MIND!
TATE: It raises SP. ATK and… LIZA: It raises SP. DEF!
TATE: It's a move that's perfect… LIZA: For PSYCHIC POKéMON!
… … … … … …
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredTateAndL: Registered GYM LEADERS TATE & LIZA in the POKéNAV.
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPostBat:
TATE: Looks like the bond between you and your POKéMON is far stronger than the bond that we share as twins.
LIZA: You will become even stronger! We've battled you, so we know.
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaNeedTwo:
TATE: Hehehe… Were you surprised?
LIZA: That there are two GYM LEADERS?
TATE: Oops, you have only one… LIZA: POKéMON that can battle.
TATE: We can't battle that way!
LIZA: If you want to challenge us, bring some more POKéMON.
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified:
MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM
LIZA AND TATE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPreRema:
TATE: POKéMON… LIZA: POKéMON…
TATE: By changing the party's mix… LIZA: The battle style changes.
TATE: But me… LIZA: But me…
TATE: I'll always be with LIZA! LIZA: I'll always be with TATE!
TATE: Our combination… LIZA: We'll show you again and again!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaRematch: TATE: You and your POKéMON… LIZA: It's as if you were siblings!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPostRem:
TATE: You can knock us down, but we'll never stay down!
LIZA: Because the two of us, we always support each other!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaRematch:
TATE: You're back again… LIZA: You're back again…
TATE: To give us a rematch. LIZA: To give us a rematch.
TATE: But… LIZA: For our match…
TATE: You brought just one POKéMON! LIZA: You brought just one POKéMON!
TATE: We need you to bring at least… LIZA: Two POKéMON when you come back.
